text:
Lena (docs): quick PR up to consolidate auth examples in the Quickstart. goal: one canonical browser OAuth flow (dev-portal) and a short CLI token appendix. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1012 — please sanity-check snippets.

Diego (eng): scanning. will swap any `client.chat.*` examples to `client.responses.generate(...)`. also propose renaming env to RW_API_KEY (long-lived) + RW_EPHEM for ephemeral to be explicit.

Mira (devex): i'll update the quickstart generator templates after merge. note: generator currently emits single-quote style; examples should match to avoid lint churn.

Lena (docs): good catch. PR includes code style note. main example shows browser OAuth with `RW_DEV_PORTAL=true`, appendix shows CLI: `tools/auth-exchange --ttl 600`.

Noah (qa): i'll run the container smoke test. what exact commands should I run?

Lena (docs): pasted from PR: ``
# build
docker build -t rw-hello:pr1012 .
# dev-portal path
docker run -e RW_DEV_PORTAL=true -p 3000:3000 rw-hello:pr1012
# cli token path
docker run -e RW_EPHEM=eyJ... -p 3000:3000 rw-hello:pr1012
# smoke
curl -s http://localhost:3000/api/greet
``
Expect: {"message":"Hello from Redwood"}.

Diego (eng): pushed a tiny fix: replaced `cache: true` with `sessionCache: 'auto'` and updated Docker base to `node:20-alpine`.

Noah (qa): when running dev-portal path I got a 500 on /auth/callback if REDWOOD_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID isn't set. recommend adding a friendly error and doc link.

Diego (eng): will add a guard returning 400 + link to the FAQ. pushing now.

Sam (pm): please add a short migration table mapping old names: RW_TOKEN -> RW_API_KEY and `client.chat.completions.create` -> `client.responses.generate`. that will help workshop instructors.

Lena (docs): added migration table and an "Instructor checklist" (node version, env vars, ports). also included an FAQ item for the /auth/callback 400.

Mira (devex): ran formatter on examples and patched generator. note: code style CI flagged a trailing comma in examples/hello/app.js. fixed.

ci-bot: CI started for branch docs/auth-consolidate-1012  build 3341 queued.

ci-bot: build 3341 failed in docs-lint (examples/hello/app.js: trailing comma).

Lena (docs): removed trailing comma and clarified OAuth redirect sample in README.

ci-bot: build 3342 passed  preview: https://deploy-preview-1012.redwood.dev

Noah (qa): reran container after Diego's guard and Mira's fixes  smoke passes. curl /api/greet returns expected message.

Sam (pm): thanks all. merge if no objections. i'll notify partner workshop leads about the migration blurb.

Lena (docs): merging in 30m unless any blockers. thanks for the quick reviews! :rocket:
